summary: PR 619 at af67c141fc79fab979c0446a0f2001e15211e468 is valid test-only hardening and an honest limitation report, not a fix for the original SSA phi/VGPR spill issue. Its exact single-if test passes unchanged on base and candidate with byte-identical gfx950 LLVM IR and ISA. No implementation or native code changed.

tests.what_was_measured: Untouched base on assigned gfx950: exact analytical numerical match; 32 phi <4 x float>; 160 MFMAs; 33 unique MFMA destination groups; 138 VGPRs; zero spills.
Exact candidate on gfx950: identical numerical and compiler metrics to base. Base/candidate SHA-256 matched for LLVM IR and final ISA.
gfx942 cross-codegen only: 32 vector phis; 160 MFMAs; 33 unique destinations; 138 VGPRs; zero spills. No gfx942 execution.
Production MLA collection is blocked because prepared aiter requires triton>=3.6.0 but the pinned environment has 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8.

gpu_execution_evidence: The single-if characterization executed on the assigned gfx950 MI355X and exactly matched an independently constructed Torch result. The production MLA kernel and gfx942 were not executed.
remaining_counterexamples: The candidate has one scf.IfOp, not the reported six branch instances with production register pressure.
The candidate test passes unchanged on the base, so there is no failing-before/passing-after regression.

No lowering or LLVM implementation changes are present; fly-promote-regmem-to-vectorssa remains in the pipeline and mutable physical-register semantics for memref_alloca(Register) are not implemented.
The production MLA test is blocked by the prepared aiter/Triton version mismatch, leaving its spills and numerical output unverified.
gfx942 was only cross-compiled because the assigned GPU is gfx950.
remaining_limitations: The production six-branch pattern and original gfx942 runtime cannot be executed in the prepared environment. The candidate is accepted only as bounded characterization coverage and accurate reporting; it does not resolve the upstream feature request.
